definitions.final_for_curated_sample: the evaluation is final for exactly these 740 pairs of this curated 20-offer development sample; its scope is limited to this curated sample and does not generalize to the full market
definitions.historical: the frozen v0.2.0 account (label distribution, metrics, first-vs-second comparison, and the 7-item human-review queue) preserved verbatim for audit
definitions.human_review_decisions: the seven approved decisions (HR-01..HR-07), each with source id, skill id, first-pass label when available, original second-pass label, final label, approval date/source, criterion, preserved reason/question/notes, and preserved evidence references
definitions.macro: unweighted mean of per-skill precision/recall/F1 over taxonomy skills with at least one non-uncertain final-label pair; skills with no defined value (all labels not_supported) are excluded and listed explicitly
definitions.primary_micro: pair-level contingency pooled over all non-uncertain final labels: supported+predicted=TP, supported+not predicted=FN, not_supported+predicted=FP, not_supported+not predicted=TN; precision=TP/(TP+FP), recall=TP/(TP+FN), F1=2*P*R/(P+R) with safe zero denominators
definitions.uncertain: ambiguous mentions reported separately and excluded from every primary denominator; zero after the human adjudication
